CustomField.description: Eight release-critical checks, percent ready. Spec Section 7.1. Multiplied by 100 to match the spec expected 100 percent on a Percent formula field.
CustomField.formula: ( IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Sod_Type__c))), 1, 0) + IF(Sod_Sqft__c > 0, 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Irrigation_Type__c))), 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Lot_Layout_Link__c)), 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(BMG_Package_Code__c)), 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Assigned_FM__c)), 1, 0) + IF(NOT(ISBLANK(ServiceTerritory__c)), 1, 0) + IF(Number_Of_Lots__c > 0, 1, 0) ) / 8 * 100
CustomField.label: Scope Ready %
